race.description: Narromine Dolly Parton Festival Sat 10 Oct Hcp (C1)
race.comment: I'M A BEAUT (11) resumes after a break of five-and-a-half months. Won on debut to launch the last campaign over 1100m at Dubbo. Ran fifth in a trial at Hawkesbury over 1000m recently. Comes to hand quickly so a bold showing is expected. MAZORT (12) was too good for a maiden field last start over 1000m at Dubbo, scoring by a nose. Is lightly raced and has plenty of scope for improvement. Harder here but should be involved in the finish. QUASIMOTO (8) raced below his best last time when seventh over 1200m at Moree, beaten 6 lengths after being in contention on the corner. Is better than that and has the talent to put the recent run behind him. RULE OF FAITH (3) best of the rest while fresh.
